action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== server container process ==="; docker compose exec -T server sh -c 'ps aux | head -20' 2>&1; echo "=== minio console health ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "minio9001 -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:9001; echo "=== postgres user ==="; docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U nebu -d nebu -c "select current_user, current_database();" 2>&1; echo "=== minio app policy/bucket check via mc ==="; docker compose run --rm --entrypoint sh createbuckets -c 'mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD" >/dev/null 2>&1; mc ls local;' 2>&1 | head
